explanation: This component is 0 almost everywhere and spikes to about 9-10 only at the GO step when the agent chooses a1 right after a rewarded visit to S1 that followed an unrewarded trial or a recent stretch on a2/S2, so it marks the first S1 reward that flips or confirms the agent toward S1; it shows up mostly in trials 20-55, and similar cases late in the episode stay near 0. It drops back to 0 at the very next GO even if S1 keeps paying (a second first reward right after gives a weaker value, about 4), and it is always 0 at D1, at D2 and whenever a2 is chosen.
